title: Don't judge police officers without all the facts
article: A letter from Dave Dickson, Surrey.

In my 25 years as a police officer in the Downtown Eastside, I have witnessed many things that have caused me to shake my head but none so much as Allan Chad's comments about the shooting of Gerald Chenery. I would welcome the opportunity to show Chad how fast things can happen and how effective a baton and pepper spray would be if one were even able to get to them in time to stop a man with a knife.

I am very sorry for Chenery and his family. But if it were me in the alley that night instead of the two young officers, I would have done nothing different. Then, like them, I would have to find a way to live with my actions.
I am truly sorry for everyone involved in this ordeal.
